title: Hungry-Hound
description: Built a responsive food ordering platform using MERN, enabling users to browse menus, add items to the cart, and place orders seamlessly. Integrated real-time data fetching from a RESTful API to display dynamic content such as food categories, pricing, order history, etc

title: Movie Explorer App
description: Developed a responsive movie discovery application using React.js, integrating real-time data from The Movie Database (TMDb) API to display trending films, ratings, release years, and languages. Implemented an optimized search algorithm with debounced input handling to enhance user experience by reducing unnecessary API calls.
